definition: Where the survey image of NGC 4874 fades into its sky, measured here on the cleaned cutout in 10 arcsec elliptical annuli: 240 arcsec along the major axis, 110.7 kpc at 95.1 Mpc. Not a published size of the galaxy.
presentation: Where the volume ends: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary of the galaxy.
